review_mode: independent read-only source review plus hash verification of recorded CPU validation; no new model performance experiment

observed_cpu_validation.llm_fixture: tiny random GPT2, not pretrained SmolLM performance

resolved_review_points: Parent model.to(device) retains official EEG encoder on CPU float32 through explicit _apply override.
Frozen encoder and LLM parameter gradients are disabled; connector remains trainable through the frozen LLM computation.
Runtime config seals encoder identity, class token IDs, core source and new module source before shared evaluator restore.
Registered training settings and train-only capacity selection evidence are checked against runtime configuration.
compatibility_checks: Same 8x448 original arrays are sealed in checkpoints; EEGStore selects only the final256 samples, resamples to200 and applies V*1e4.
No target answer token is supplied; training and scoring use the same three restricted next-token logits.
Prompt uses fixed class mapping and original pre-window environment only; true label is added only to output records.
Same held-out IDs and same best checkpoint across all five conditions; within-recording derangement and separately identified raw-minus10-second sources retain existing provenance checks.
No modifications to the frozen e308 model or bd927 evaluator were made.
limitations: The v3 test results were already seen before this exploratory design; this is not a fresh confirmatory test.
Encoder and scoring objective change together, so any later difference cannot be attributed independently to either change.
Actual used EEG is1second inside a1.75second original window; these durations must not be conflated.
Zero EEG context-only is a distribution-shift input-removal ablation of one fused checkpoint.
Released EEG was already filtered offline; online causality and actual latent intent remain unverified.
Restricted-token softmax is not proven natural-use calibration.
GPU sustained capacity, final model performance and M1 trial are separate experiments not established by this code review.
